facts.fact: LTA Chairman Massaquoi says private firms are helping extend the fibre-optic network from Buchanan to Rivercess, Sinoe, Maryland, Grand Gedeh and Nimba counties, with work ongoing to interconnect all regions; no contract is described.
LTA Chairman Massaquoi says the fibre line had already reached Loguatuo from Monrovia; no length or date given, so dated by publication.

systems.system: second submarine cable landing at Buchanan (planned)
